articles.title: Verstappen wins in Malaysia after long delays as Russell retires
articles.description: Max Verstappen takes his and Red Bull's first win of the year with a dominant drive in a dramatic Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia that started amid chaotic and unprecedented scenes.

articles.title: 'Incredible' Red Bull upgrade enlivens F1 in 'roasting hot' Malaysia
articles.description: Even Lewis Hamilton fears Max Verstappen will be tough to beat in Sunday's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

articles.title: F1: Chequered Flag
articles.description: Will we get a repeat of Verstappen & Hamilton’s epic 2021 battle into turn one at Sepang?

articles.title: Verstappen takes first 2026 pole ahead of Hamilton
articles.description: Max Verstappen takes his and Red Bull's first pole position of 2026 with an imperious performance in qualifying at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

articles.title: Russell says Red Bull strongest after Bahrain practice
articles.description: Red Bull are tipped by George Russell and Charles Leclerc as the team to beat after the first day at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
